title: SEEO Multi-Cloud Orchestrator
summary: SEEO is a Rails and React multi-cloud control plane for safe, short-lived environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and OCI.

notes.label: Build
notes.text: Rails and React coordinate provider adapters, normalized lifecycle state, tenant scope, OPA/Rego policy checks, ActionCable updates, and TTL cleanup.

notes.label: Scope
notes.text: The public demo runs in mock mode. It does not create cloud resources or require provider credentials.

proof: Provider adapter contract tests, persisted lifecycle state, tenant-scoped live updates, Terraform foundations, mock mode, and CI security artifacts.
